_description: StateSet iCommerce Channel Gateway - Example Configuration

telegram._description: Telegram Bot via grammy. Requires TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN env var.

discord._description: Discord Bot via discord.js. Requires DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN env var.

slack._description: Slack Bot via @slack/bolt. Requires SLACK_BOT_TOKEN and SLACK_APP_TOKEN env vars.

whatsapp._description: WhatsApp via Baileys (QR-code auth). Stores auth at authDir path.

signal._description: Signal via signal-cli JSON-RPC. Requires signalNumber.

google-chat._description: Google Chat via Pub/Sub. Requires credentials and subscription.

shared._description: Shared configuration applied to all channel gateways.

httpGateway._description: HTTP API server for management and plugin routes.
